batch.topic: A shop customer receives store credit for a returned item but no cash refund; preserve both the amount of credit and what cannot be exchanged.
A club member asks to omit a nickname from a name badge while retaining it in the private draft; invent fictional names, no real personal data.
A household postpones painting a wall until a small damp patch is assessed; a dry surface alone is not confirmation of the cause.
A courier leaves two boxes with reception but keeps the envelope requiring a signature; notification does not prove the envelope was delivered.
